question: Which term describes a person who is overly self-centered?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Narcissist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Narcissist"** refers to a person who has an excessive interest in or admiration of themselves. (स्वार्थी व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** John is such a narcissist; he spends hours every day admiring himself in the mirror.
 
 
• It describes a self-centered or egotistical individual who often disregards the needs or feelings of others.

Correct term:** Narcissist** (स्वार्थी व्यक्ति)

 
• **Example:** The narcissist could not understand why people didn’t like his constant boasting.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Narcissist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Altruist** (परोपकारी): Someone who is selfless and concerned with the welfare of others.
 
 
• **Example:** The altruist spends his weekends volunteering at the local animal shelter.
 
 
 
• **Philanthropist** (सद्भावना रखने वाला): A person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by donating money to good causes.
 
 
• **Example:** The philanthropist donated millions to support education for underprivileged children.
 
 
 
• **Optimist** (आशावादी): Someone who always looks at the positive side of things and expects good outcomes.
 
 
• **Example:** Even in difficult situations, she remains an optimist and believes things will get better.
 
 

4d:T8e6,

The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Coup**.
